title: Delete .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md, the last Codex-bridge artifact in this repo
description: Flagged by opum-agent while verifying QCLI-230/OPAG-38: with AGENTS.md deleted, .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md (generated by lore init --codex, do-not-hand-edit) is retired machinery criterion 4 wants gone. Correcting the stated reason after reading lore-cli's own source rather than relaying the claim: hasCodexBridge (lore-cli src/commands/agents.ts:178-184) arms lore's Codex-bridge maintenance if EITHER .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md OR an AGENTS.md carrying the codex block is present - the SKILL.md file's own presence is independently sufficient (line 182: 'if (codexSkillRaw !== undefined) return true'). So this file is not an orphan with no writer; deleting it (now that AGENTS.md is already gone) is what actually and deliberately opts this repository out of lore's Codex bridge, matching the documented pattern ('a repository that never opted into Codex has no .codex/ tree', doc comment lines 169-173). Only file under .codex/ in this repo (confirmed via find); no .codex/skills/backlog-handover/ present.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .codex/ is removed from this repository (the one file it held, skills/lore/SKILL.md)
lore check and lore agents --check both still exit 0 afterward, confirming the deletion is the correct opt-out and not a state lore will try to recreate or flag as drift

implementationNotes: AC2 revised on discovery: 'lore agents --check' was ALREADY exit 6 on dev before this change (verified via git stash: pre-deletion output listed 'out-of-date-protected .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md' plus 'out-of-date AGENTS.md' plus 'up-to-date .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md' - three lines, exit 6). That .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md drift is pre-existing and unrelated to this task's scope, not something this deletion caused or can fix; filing it separately rather than silently expanding scope or forcing a regeneration I haven't verified is safe. What IS this task's evidence: post-deletion, the .codex/ entry is gone entirely from 'lore agents --check' output (confirming hasCodexBridge correctly reads the repo as opted out, not as drifted or missing something to recreate) and 'lore check' (the doc-content check, the actual OPAG-38 criterion 2) stays exit 0/0 errors. Checking AC2 on that narrower, accurate basis rather than the overly broad 'both exit 0' wording originally filed.
finalSummary: Deleted .codex/ (its one file, skills/lore/SKILL.md), correcting the record en route: lore-cli's hasCodexBridge (src/commands/agents.ts:178-184) arms Codex-bridge maintenance on EITHER artifact's presence, so the file was not an orphan with no writer as first reported - deleting it (with AGENTS.md already gone) is what actually opts this repo out, per lore's own documented pattern. Verified: pre-deletion the file was 'up-to-date' (actively maintained, not stale); post-deletion the codex entry disappears from lore agents --check entirely (correct opt-out, not drift) and lore check stays 0 errors. lore agents --check's pre-existing, unrelated .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md 'out-of-date-protected' failure (confirmed present on dev before this change via git stash) is out of scope here and needs its own task.
